summary: Lanvin Group Holdings Limited furnished a Form 6-K disclosing the early repayment in full of a fixed-rate secured loan note originally issued to Meritz Securities on June 27, 2025, tied to the company's repurchase of 13,804,733 ordinary shares. The note's original principal was EUR48.1 million, with EUR8.5 million repaid June 30, 2025 and further partial prepayments thereafter; remaining principal, accrued interest and other amounts were settled ahead of the December 14, 2026 maturity. Related security will be released. This is a routine debt-retirement update, not a special situation; watch deleveraging and buyback-overhang mechanics.
